question: The characteristic garlicky odour of garlic is due to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garlic** belongs to the **Allium family **of vegetables, which also includes **onions, leeks, and shallots.**
 
• When garlic is **chopped or crushed,** it releases an enzyme called **alliinase**, which converts **alliin **(an amino acid) into **allicin **(an organosulfur compound).
 
• Allicin is responsible for the** pungent smell and taste** of garlic.
 
• When allicin breaks down, it produces a variety of **sulfur-containing compounds**, including** diallyl disulfide, allyl mercaptan, and allyl methyl sulfide**, which give garlic its characteristic garlicky odour.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iodine** is a chemical element that is essential for the production of **thyroid hormones** in the body.

 
 
• It is often used as a **disinfectant **and in the treatment of **thyroid disorders.**
 
 
 
• **Copper** is a metal that is commonly used in **electrical wiring, plumbing, and construction**.
 
 
• It is also an important nutrient for the human body and is involved in the production of **red blood cells.**
 
 
 
• **Chlorine** is a chemical element that is commonly used as a **disinfectant in swimming pools **and **drinking water.**
 
 
• It is also used in the production of many** household and industrial chemicals.**
 
 
 
• **Sulphur **is a chemical element that is found in many** minerals and organic **compounds.
 
 
• It is used in the production of **fertilizers, pesticides,** and other chemicals.
 
• It is also an important nutrient for** plants and animals.**
